{{Quote|My client represents the charitable arm of a corporation producing water vaporators. All local vaporators were provided at a steep discount by my client.|[[Neb Munb]]|<ref name="TOR" />}}
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], a '''corporation''' produced [[Moisture vaporator/Legends|moisture vaporators]]. A [[Neb Munb's client|man]] who worked for the corporation's charitable arm sold vaporators at a steep discount in [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. However, the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lords]] who had previously controlled the water supply hired someone to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the [[Gender/Legends|man]].<ref name="TOR" />
